run_get_example_data: run get_example_data to obtain a model, input tensor, category ID, and labels for benchmarking
run_get_module: run get_module to retrieve a nested submodule from a model using a dotted path string
create_Probe: create a Probe on a model layer to capture activations and gradients during forward and backward passes
run_gradient_to_linear_approx_saliency: run gradient_to_linear_approx_saliency to convert captured gradient data into a linear approximation saliency map
run_plot_example: run plot_example to visualize an input tensor alongside its computed saliency map with a title
